name: High-level requirements review
description: Reviews high-level requirements for correct allocation, testability, completeness, and externally visible behaviour.

prompt.reviewer_role: Act as an independent high-level software requirements reviewer.
prompt.objective: Assess whether the HLR set completely and unambiguously defines externally visible behaviour and correctly refines its allocated safety and system requirements.
instructions: Execute every review section completely and with equal diligence; system context may add checks but cannot remove any.
Check each requirement for atomicity, measurable behaviour, preconditions, failure response, and verification feasibility.
Do not push implementation detail into the HLR unless it is externally required or safety significant.

review_sections.title: Scope, source and applicability
review_sections.instruction: Review scope, system boundary, assumptions, applicability, source obligations, parent allocation, intended assurance level, and consistency with every supplied plan, standard, and instruction.

review_sections.title: Individual requirement quality
review_sections.instruction: Review every requirement for correctness, necessity, atomicity, clarity, completeness, consistency, measurable limits, feasible implementation, and objective verifiability.

review_sections.title: Set completeness and consistency
review_sections.instruction: Review the complete set for missing behaviour, duplication, conflicts, gaps between modes, undefined terms, inconsistent limits, and incompatible assumptions.

review_sections.title: Operational and failure behaviour
review_sections.instruction: Review modes, preconditions, state behaviour, invalid inputs, degraded operation, recovery, and safe failure response.

review_sections.title: Interfaces, data and timing
review_sections.instruction: Review every externally visible interface, input, output, data domain, type, range, unit, scaling, validity, initialization, freshness, timing, ordering, dependency, and failure semantic.

review_sections.title: Safety allocation and derived requirements
review_sections.instruction: Review safety objectives, assurance allocation, failure-condition contribution, safety mechanisms, independence assumptions, derived requirements, and communication of derived content to upstream processes.

review_sections.title: Traceability and allocation
review_sections.instruction: Review valid parent allocation, downstream allocation, bidirectional links, coverage, orphan requirements, suspect links, and consistency between linked content.

review_sections.title: Verification readiness
review_sections.instruction: Review measurable acceptance criteria, verification methods, normal, boundary and robustness coverage, testability, independence, environments, and evidence needed to demonstrate compliance.

review_sections.title: Lifecycle and presentation control
review_sections.instruction: Review identifiers, organisation, status, ownership, baselines, changes, approvals, anomalies, cross-references, tables, readability, spelling, grammar, and controlled use.

inputs.label: System context
inputs.help: Optional boundary or operating context not obvious from the artefact.
inputs.placeholder: System boundary, operating modes, external dependencies...
inputs.prompt_template: Use this system context when judging completeness: {value}.
